sanskrit: brahmāṇa indraṃ mahayanto arkairavardhayannahaye hantavā u
english: The priests, magnifying Indra with hymns, strengthened him for the slaying of the serpent.

sanskrit: anavaste rathamaśvāya takṣustvaṣṭā vajraṃ puruhūta dyumantam
english: They fashioned the chariot for the horse; Tvaṣṭā forged the brilliant thunderbolt for the much-invoked one.

sanskrit: śaṃ padaṃ maghaṃ rayīṣiṇo na kāmamavrato hinoti na spṛśadrayim
english: Auspicious is the step, the bounty, the desire of the wealthy man; the one who lacks vows neither impels nor touches riches.

sanskrit: sadā gāvaḥ śucayo viśvadhāyasaḥ sadā devā arepasaḥ
english: Ever pure are the cows, nourishing all things; ever blameless are the gods.

sanskrit: ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta varttaniṃ yadūdhabhiḥ
english: Come with the forest; the cows with their udders follow the path.

sanskrit: upa prakṣe madhumati kṣiyantaḥ puṣyema rayiṃ dhīmahe ta indra
english: Dwelling beside the honey-sweet refreshment, may we thrive in wealth; we hold meditation on you, O Indra.

sanskrit: arcantyarkaṃ marutaḥ svarkkā ā stobhati śruto yuvā sa indraḥ
english: The Maruts sing the hymn of praise; the youthful, renowned Indra responds with his shout of glory.

sanskrit: pra va indrāya vṛtrahantamāya viprāya gāthaṃ gāyata yaṃ jujoṣate
english: Sing forth to Indra, the foremost slayer of Vṛtra, the inspired sage — sing the song that he delights in.

sanskrit: agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhuvo varūthyaḥ
english: O Agni, you are our nearest kin and our protector; be auspicious, be our shelter.

sanskrit: bhago na citro agnirmahonāṃ dadhāti ratnam
english: Agni, brilliant like Bhaga, bestows the gem upon those of great might.

sanskrit: viśvasya pra stobha puro vā sanyadi veha nūnam
english: Shout forth before all things; whether it was won of old or is won here now.

sanskrit: uṣā apa svasuṣṭamaḥ saṃ varttayati varttaniṃ sujātatā
english: Dawn, most beneficent of sisters, rolls the path along by her noble birth.

sanskrit: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhemendraśca viśve ca devāḥ
english: May we prosper these worlds — both Indra and all the gods together.

sanskrit: vi srutayo yathā patha indra tvadyantu rātayaḥ
english: As rivers spread along their courses, O Indra, so may your gifts flow forth.

sanskrit: ayā vājaṃ devahitaṃ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ
english: By this may we win the prize established by the gods; may we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in brave sons.

sanskrit: ūrjā mitro varuṇaḥ pinvateḍāḥ pīvarīmiṣaṃ kṛṇuhī na indra
english: Mitra and Varuṇa make the refreshing draughts swell with strength; make our nourishment rich, O Indra.

sanskrit: indro viśvasya rājati
english: Indra reigns over all things.

sanskrit: sa īṃ mamāda mahi karma karttave mahāmuruṃ sainaṃ saścaddevo devaṃ satya induḥ satyamindram
english: He rejoiced to perform the great deed; the great, vast one — the god accompanied the god, the true Soma the true Indra.

sanskrit: ayaṃ sahasramānavo dṛśaḥ kavīnāṃ matirjyotirvidharma . bradhnaḥ samīcīruṣasaḥ samairayadarepasaḥ socetasaḥ svasare manyumantaścitā goḥ
english: This one, the thought of the seers, is visible to a thousand men, a light that upholds the law; the mighty one set the Dawns in alignment — the blameless, like-minded ones, ardent in their day, discerning of the cow.

sanskrit: endra yāhyupa naḥ parāvato nāyamacchā vidathānīva satpatirastā rājeva satpatiḥ . havāmahe tvā prayasvantaḥ suteṣvā putrāso na pitaraṃ vājasātaye maṃhiṣṭhaṃ vājasātaye
english: Come to us, O Indra, from afar, onward toward us as a true lord of the assembly, as a king who is a true lord. We invoke you, offering forth at the pressings, as sons invoke a father, the most bountiful one, for the winning of the prize.

sanskrit: tamindraṃ johavīmi maghavānamugraṃ satrā dadhānamapratiṣkutaṃ śravāṃsi bhūriḥ . maṃhiṣṭho gīrbhirā ca yajñiyo vavartta rāye no viśvā supathā kṛṇotu vajrī
english: I loudly call on that Indra, the bountiful, the mighty, who holds undivided and unchallenged fame in abundance; most generous, he has turned back with our hymns, the worshipful one; may the wielder of the thunderbolt make all good paths open to us for wealth.

sanskrit: astu śrauṣṭpuro agniṃ dhiyā dadha ā nu tyacchardho divyaṃ vṛṇīmaha indravāyū vṛṇīmahe . yaddha krāṇā vivasvate nābhā sandāya navyase . adha pra nūnamupa yanti dhītayo devāṃacchā na dhītayaḥ
english: Let there be a call to hear; set Agni forward with thought; now we choose that divine host, we choose Indra and Vāyu. When the active ones bind at the navel for Vivasvat renewed, then now the prayers go forth toward the gods, as prayers indeed.

sanskrit: pra vo mahe matayo yantu viṣṇave marutvate girijā evayāmarut . pra śardhāya pra yajyave sukhādaye tavase bhandadiṣṭaye dhunivratāya śavase
english: Let your great praises go forth to Viṣṇu accompanied by the Maruts, born of the mountain — Evayāmarut. Forward to the host, to the worshipful one, to the joyous one, to the powerful, to the glorious purpose, to the one of roaring vows, for strength.

sanskrit: ayā rucā hariṇyā punāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi tarati sayugvabhiḥ sūro na sayugvabhiḥ . dhārā pṛṣṭhasya rocate punāno aruṣo hariḥ . viśvā yadrūpā pariyāsyṛkvabhiḥ saptāsyebhirṛkvabhiḥ
english: Purifying himself with this golden radiance, he crosses all hatreds along with his yokemates, like the sun with his yokemates. The stream of his back shines as the tawny, ruddy one purifies himself. As he passes through all forms with the Ṛk verses, with the seven-mouthed Ṛk verses.

sanskrit: abhi tyaṃ devaṃ savitāramoṇyoḥ kavikratumarcāmi satyasavaṃ ratnadhāmabhi priyaṃ matim ūrdhvā yasyāmatirbhā adidyutatsavīmani hiraṇyapāṇiramimīta sukratuḥ kṛpā svaḥ
english: I hymn that god Savitṛ, of bold resolve, with both my hands — the true impeller, dwelling in gems — with the dear thought; he whose thought blazed upward in radiance at the impulse; golden-handed, of bright resolve, he measured out the sky with grace.

sanskrit: agniṃ hotāraṃ manye dāsvantaṃ vasoḥ sūnuṃ sahaso jātavedasaṃ vipraṃ na jātavedasam . ya ūrdhvayā svadhvaro devo devācyā kṛpā . ghṛtasya vibhrāṣṭimanu śukraśociṣa ājuhvānasya sarpiṣaḥ
english: I honor Agni the Hotṛ, generous, son of strength, the all-knowing, inspired like the all-knowing one; who, upright and well-sacrificing, a god by divine grace, follows the blazing of ghee, the bright-flaming one, as the clarified butter is poured.

sanskrit: tava tyannaryaṃ nṛto 'pa indra prathamaṃ pūrvyaṃ divi pravācyaṃ kṛtam . yo devasya śavasā prāriṇā asu riṇannapaḥ . bhuvo viśvamabhyadevamojasā videdūrjaṃ śatakraturvidediṣam
english: That heroic deed of yours, O manly Indra, was done first of all in heaven, worthy to be proclaimed; you who by the god's strength set the rivers flowing as you caused the waters to flow. You have become all things beyond the gods in power; the hundred-crafted one has found strength, has found refreshment.

sanskrit: uccā te jātamandhaso divi sadbhūmyā dade . ugraṃ śarma mahi śravaḥ
english: What is born of your invigorating draught, high in heaven, dwelling on the earth — mighty shelter, great renown.

sanskrit: svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā . indrāya pātave sutaḥ
english: Flow with your sweetest, most exhilarating stream, O Soma; pressed, you flow for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: vṛṣā pavasva dhārayā marutvate ca matsaraḥ . viśvā dadhāna ojasā
english: Flow forth as a bull with your stream, and exhilarating for him who has the Maruts, bearing all things with your might.

sanskrit: yaste mado vareṇyastenā pavasvāndhasā . devāvīraghaśaṃsahā
english: With that exhilaration of yours which is most choice, flow forth with your juice — slayer of the demon, defender of the divine hero.

sanskrit: tisro vāca udīrate gāvo mimanti dhenavaḥ . harireti kanikradat
english: Three voices rise up; the cows low, the milch cows cry; the tawny one comes lowing aloud.

sanskrit: indrāyendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamaḥ . arkasya yonimāsadam
english: Purify yourself, O drop, for Indra accompanied by the Maruts, most rich in sweetness; sit down in the womb of the hymn.

sanskrit: asāvyaṃśurmadāyāpsu dakṣo giriṣṭhāḥ . śyeno na yonimāsadat
english: The shoot has been pressed for exhilaration; the dexterous one stands on the mountains in the waters; like a falcon he has sat down in his birthplace.

sanskrit: pavasva dakṣasādhano devebhyaḥ pītaye hare . marudbhyo vāyave madaḥ
english: Purify yourself, accomplishing power, O tawny one, for the gods to drink — exhilaration for the Maruts, for Vāyu.

sanskrit: pari svāno giriṣṭhāḥ pavitre somo akṣarat . madeṣu sarvadhā asi
english: The roaring one standing on the mountains, Soma has flowed around the filter; in exhilarations you are the bearer of all things.

sanskrit: pari priyā divaḥ kavirvayāṃsi naptyorhitaḥ . svānairyāti kavikratuḥ
english: The seer, dear to heaven, placed among the grandchildren's birds, goes forth with his sounds, the one of bold resolve.

sanskrit: sutā vidathe akramuḥ
english: The pressed drops have stepped forward at the sacred assembly.

sanskrit: pra somāso vipaścito 'po nayanta ūrmayaḥ . vanāni mahiṣā iva
english: The wise Soma juices flow forth, the waves lead the waters, like great buffaloes through the forests.

sanskrit: pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ kṛdhī no yaśaso jane . viśvā apa dviṣo jahi
english: Purify yourself, O drop, a bull when pressed; make us glorious among the people; smite away all enemies.

sanskrit: vṛṣā hyasi bhānunā dyumantaṃ tvā havāmahe . pavamāna svardṛśam
english: For you are truly a bull by your radiance; we invoke you, the brilliant one, O self-purifying one, who sees the heavenly light.

sanskrit: induḥ paviṣṭa cetanaḥ priyaḥ kavīnāṃ matiḥ . sṛjadaśvaṃ rathīriva
english: The drop has entered the filter, the conscious one, dear as the thought of the seers; he releases the horse as a charioteer.

sanskrit: asṛkṣata pra vājino gavyā somāso aśvayā . śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ
english: The vigorous Soma juices have been released forward, seeking cattle, seeking horses; the bright, swift ones seeking heroes.

sanskrit: pavasva deva āyuṣagindraṃ gacchatu te madaḥ . vāyumā roha dharmaṇā
english: Purify yourself, O god, extending life; let your exhilaration go to Indra; mount Vāyu by the law.

sanskrit: pavamāno ajījanaddivaścitraṃ na tanyatum . jyotirvaiśvānaraṃ bṛhat
english: The self-purifying one has begotten the brilliant light of heaven, like thunder; the great light belonging to all men.

sanskrit: pari svānāsa indavo madāya barhaṇā girā . madho arṣanti dhārayā
english: The drops, the Indu juices, flow around for exhilaration with powerful song; they rush with their stream of sweetness.

sanskrit: pari prāsiṣyadatkaviḥ sindhorūrmāvadhi śritaḥ . kāruṃ bibhratpuruspṛham
english: The seer has flowed around and settled on the wave of the river; bearing the singer, much-desired.
